bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: Running back D'Andre Swift was named NFC Offensive Player of the Week after his three-touchdown performance in Chicago's record-setting 59-37 season-opening win over the Panthers, a feat that came shortly after he signed a contract extension keeping him with the Bears through 2029. Chicago Bears running back D'Andre Swift was named NFC Offensive Player of the Week on Wednesday after powering Chicago's record-setting 59-37 season-opening win at Carolina, coming five days after agreeing to a new contract that will keep him in Chicago through the 2029 campaign.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions are gearing up to face the Buffalo Bills on Thursday night in Week 2, with the team releasing its injury report and game designations for Wednesday, September 16, ahead of the road matchup at 8:15 p.m. EDT .

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Packers are still dealing with fallout from their Week 1 collapse in Minneapolis, where they let a fourth-quarter lead slip away as coach Matt LaFleur faces scrutiny over his fourth-down decision-making and a shaky new-look offensive line in the loss to the Vikings. Adding to the storylines, edge rusher Micah Parsons has been vocal about his leadership role as he continues rehabbing, while the team also made a minor roster move by releasing WR Chris Hilton Jr.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Vikings placed running back Jordan Mason on injured reserve and signed DeeJay Dallas from the practice squad ahead of their Week 2 matchup against the Chicago Bears. Quarterback Kyler Murray remains in the concussion protocol as Minnesota heads into Week 2, leaving Carson Wentz—who rallied the team to a Week 1 win over Green Bay behind Justin Jefferson's historic performance—as the likely starter.
